title: Smoke subsides for some in the state, effects continue elsewhere
snippet: Smoke is still in the picture on Friday, but the Air Quality Health Advisory area is smaller than yesterday. Some areas in Colorado will see improved air quality today, but smoke from fires in-state and to our north will impact northern Colorado, southwest Colorado, and the northern Front Range. What's driving this change? A shift in the upper- level winds. Earlier this week, upper-level winds from the west brought smoke into Colorado from Utah and Nevada. Today, the upper-level winds have…
